recognize_zh: 低中倍 H&E 下骨小樑明顯增厚、形狀不規則且互相連接，占據大部分切面（骨硬化），骨小樑間的空間則被含紡錘狀細胞的纖維組織與擴張血管取代，幾乎看不到正常造血，符合原發性骨髓纖維化纖維化期伴骨硬化。
features: Markedly thickened, irregular and anastomosing bony trabeculae occupying much of the section (osteosclerosis)
Trabeculae with haphazard lamellae and new bone formation around vascular canals
Intertrabecular spaces filled by loose fibrous stroma with spindle cell nuclei in a streaming pattern
Scattered dilated sinusoids and small vessels with red cells; small fat vacuoles
Marked depletion of normal hematopoietic cells
describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow trephine section shows marked osteosclerosis, with thickened, irregular and anastomosing bony trabeculae showing new bone formation. The intertrabecular spaces are replaced by fibrous stroma with streaming spindle-shaped nuclei and scattered dilated sinusoids, with near-complete loss of normal hematopoiesis. Findings are consistent with the fibrotic stage of primary myelofibrosis with osteosclerosis (MF-3); reticulin and trichrome stains, assessment of residual megakaryocytes and JAK2, CALR or MPL mutation testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: Hyperparathyroidism shows osteoclastic tunneling resorption with peritrabecular fibrosis, whereas this field shows new bone apposition with diffuse intertrabecular fibrosis.
Sclerotic metastases contain cohesive carcinoma cells within the stroma that are keratin positive.
Paget disease shows mosaic cement lines with prominent osteoclasts and osteoblasts, typically without marrow-wide hematopoietic failure.
Mastocytosis may cause osteosclerosis but shows spindle mast cell aggregates positive for tryptase and CD25.
